name: encode_concordance
description: Per-biosample ENCODE accessibility × RNA-seq/GTEx concordance gene sets (concordant_active, open_silent, expressed_closed, bgsneak_delta, GTEx enriched/not-accessible)

inputs.name: accessible_genes_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-biosample raw accessible gene set subdirs (encode_accessible_genes output). Each subdir must contain geneset.tsv and optionally geneset.meta.json. Provides raw-mode accessible genes.

inputs.name: contrast_dir
inputs.description: Directory of LOO-contrast accessible gene set subdirs (encode_accessibility_contrast output). Up sets (specifically accessible, LOO prevalence < 0.25) are used as control-mode accessible genes.

inputs.name: rnaseq_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-biosample RNA-seq expressed gene set subdirs. Each subdir contains geneset.tsv; biosample is read from geneset.meta.json or inferred from dir name.

inputs.name: gtex_enriched_dir
inputs.description: Directory of per-tissue GTEx tissue-enriched gene set subdirs (gtex_tissue_enriched output). Tissue name is inferred by stripping the GTEx_tissue_enriched_ prefix from the dir name.

parameters.name: assay
parameters.help: Assay label for output set names and provenance. Use 'ATAC-seq' or 'DNase-seq'. Default: ATAC-seq.

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_control_open_but_silent_<biosample>/
outputs.description: Genes accessible (LOO control) but NOT expressed

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_control_expressed_but_closed_<biosample>/
outputs.description: Genes expressed but NOT accessible (LOO control)

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_bgsneak_silent_<biosample>/
outputs.description: Background-sneak silent: accessible in raw but absorbed by LOO, not expressed

outputs.name: ENCODE_<assay>_bgsneak_expressed_<biosample>/
outputs.description: Background-sneak expressed: accessible in raw but absorbed by LOO, and expressed

outputs.name: GTEx_<assay>_control_enriched_not_accessible_<biosample>/
outputs.description: GTEx tissue-enriched but NOT accessible (LOO control)

outputs.name: GTEx_<assay>_control_open_not_enriched_<biosample>/
outputs.description: Accessible (LOO control) but NOT GTEx tissue-enriched
